about: Lessons that ship with VidGen, ready to draw. Each teaches one thing about using AI well.

lessons.name: The missing line
lessons.topic: Say what a good answer looks like

lesson.title: The missing line
lesson.caption: most prompts are missing this one line. do you add it?

hook.say: Your prompts are missing one line. And it changes every answer you get.
hook.title: ONE MISSING LINE

points.label: the problem
points.title: AI HAS TO GUESS
points.say: You ask for an email. The AI has no idea who it's for or what you want back. So it guesses, and you get something generic.

card.bad: write me an email to my boss
card.good: write a 3-line email to my boss asking for Friday off. friendly, no excuses.

points.label: the fix
points.title: SAY WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE
points.say: Add one line that says what a good answer looks like. Who it's for, how long it should be, and the tone you want.

points.label: try it
points.title: ONE LINE, EVERY TIME
points.say: Before you hit send, finish this sentence. A good answer is three lines, friendly, and ready to paste.

card.label: ADD THIS
card.text: A good answer is: 3 lines, friendly, ready to paste.

close.say: One line, and the AI stops guessing. Want more of these? Search Iro AI.
close.title: STOP MAKING AI GUESS

lessons.name: Ask again
lessons.topic: The first answer is a draft: push back

lesson.title: Ask again
lesson.caption: the first answer is a draft. how many times do you ask?

hook.say: The first answer AI gives you is its most average one. Here is how to get the good one.
hook.title: FIRST ANSWER IS A DRAFT

points.label: why
points.title: IT PLAYS IT SAFE
points.say: With nothing to go on, AI gives you the safest answer it can. Fine, generic, and easy to forget.

card.text: The first answer is the average answer

points.label: the move
points.title: PUSH BACK
points.say: So push back. Tell it what you liked, what was off, and what to change.

points.label: try it
points.title: SAY IT LIKE THIS
points.say: Try this on your next one. Keep the first line, cut the rest in half, and make it sound like me.

card.label: SAY THIS
card.text: Keep the first line. Cut the rest in half. Make it sound like me.

close.say: The third message is where it gets good. Search Iro AI.
close.title: DON'T STOP AT ONE

lessons.name: Give it a role
lessons.topic: Tell the AI who to be before what to do

lesson.title: Give it a role
lesson.caption: one sentence at the start changes the whole answer. do you use it?

hook.say: One sentence at the start of your prompt changes everything after it. Most people skip it.
hook.title: THE SENTENCE YOU SKIP

points.label: the idea
points.title: GIVE IT A ROLE
points.say: Tell the AI who to be. A patient tutor, a blunt editor, a tough interviewer. It answers the way that person would.

points.label: see it
points.title: SAME QUESTION, NEW ANSWER
points.say: Ask it to explain interest rates and you get a textbook. Ask it as a tutor for a ten year old and you get something you can use.

card.good: you're a tutor for a 10-year-old. explain interest rates with one example.

points.label: the order
points.title: ROLE, THEN TASK
points.say: Put the role first, then the task, then how you want it back.

close.say: One sentence, and it stops sounding like a robot. Search Iro AI.
close.title: TELL IT WHO TO BE
